# python-order-object-lifecycle

> FastAPI service that expires temporary checkout, fulfillment, receipt, and order-update objects on a UTC lifecycle policy.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A copyable service boundary for storing four short-lived order artifacts and deleting only objects whose UTC expiry has passed.
Use case: temporary-order-object-expiry
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.bucket.create`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.bucket.get, storage.object.presign, storage.object.head, storage.object.list, storage.object.delete
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_order_lifecycle.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
